data.change_summary: Improved `check_strictly_increasing` error reporting in invariants.rs by adding a new `OrderingViolation` variant to `SimError` that carries both the lower and upper field names and values. Previously, the error only reported the upper field (e.g., `InvariantViolation { field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c", value: 30.0 }`) without mentioning the lower bound that caused the conflict. Now the error is `OrderingViolation { lower_field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_min_c", lower_value: 33.0, upper_field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c", upper_value: 30.0 }` with a message like "`shrimp_params.optimal_temp_min_c` (33) must be less than `shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c` (30)". Updated all 3 call sites in invariants.rs to pass both field names, updated the API error handler to map the new variant to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, and updated the save_load.rs test that asserts on the exact error. Also fixed two pre-existing compile issues in substrate.rs (changed `colonizable_area_factor(self)` to `&self` and added `Copy` derive to `SubstrateKind`) that were blocking workspace compilation.
outstanding_risks: Pre-existing compile errors in tank_data/src/presets.rs (missing ParamMetaPreset impl for ProcessParamsPreset) block workspace-wide `cargo clippy --all-targets` — unrelated to this task, from another task's incomplete work
